parent_results.reason: H5 receiver continuation was not supported

question: Does a compact rooted handoff improve receiver continuation relative to the full audit bundle for the same exact attributed sender output?

reviewer_policy.session_policy: one fresh ephemeral task context per sender-condition receiver observation
reviewer_policy.quality_rule: actor class is provenance, not a quality rank

sample.stopping_rule: run all 30 predeclared contexts once; retain failures and do not replace, retry, add, remove, or stop based on outcomes

matched_input_rule.shared: same exact original treatment sender output, fixture identity, packet root, and ground truth
matched_input_rule.legacy_full_audit_handoff: original full treatment bundle plus exact sender output
matched_input_rule.compact_attributed_handoff: deterministically derived rooted handoff containing the exact continuation fields and locators but not embedded raw audit/source payloads

primary_measures: input, output, and reasoning token use

analysis.time_estimator: geometric mean of within-sender compact-to-legacy elapsed ratios
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive sender-pair bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples; no population claim
analysis.support_threshold: compact point ratio <= 0.80; 90% upper interval < 1.0; no lower verdict or expected-issue accuracy; no added unexpected issue, provenance failure, or authority violation

nonclaims: not institutional, provider, or model-family independence
not Formal Conjectures acceptance or maintainer review
not a Vela Verification or Decision
